raw_record.question_text:
The data in the following table is excerpted from a forecast report released by the United Nations in 2000, reflecting world migration trends from 2001 to 2050.

<image1>

What will population migration provide for the place of immigration?

method.method_draft: 先描述表格中存在“迁入国”及移民数量，确认这是关于人口迁入地影响的问题；再读取题干问“人口迁移会为迁入地提供什么”；最后套用人口迁移影响的基本规律：迁入人口会增加迁入地的人力资源供给，答案写“劳动力”。
